data.name: Ede
data.gender_notes: Ede is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Ede was a goddess of fertility and prosperity. Her name comes from the Greek word 'ede' which means 'wealth' or 'prosperity'. In Christianity, Ede is a variant of the name Edith, which derives from the Old English 'ead' meaning 'wealth' or 'fortune'. The name Ede carries the meaning “Wealth, Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ede usually hope their child will grow to embody wealth, prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes abundance, prosperity, and the blessings of the earth.
data.etymology: Ede belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wealth, Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ede total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_hebrew.name: אדה
in_hebrew.meaning: עדה הוא שם שפירושו עוזרת, תומכת
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אדה הוא שורש עברי שפירושו עוזרת, תומכת. הוא קשור למילה העברית 'עדה' שפירושו עדות או עוזרת. השם אדה מופיע בתנ"ך ככינוי לאחת מנשותיו של לameך, אביו של נוח (בראשית 4:19-20). השם אדה הוא גם קשור לשם העברי 'אדא' שפירושו עוזר או מושיע.

in_greek.name: Έδη
in_greek.meaning: Το όνομα Έδη σημαίνει βοηθήτρια, υποστηρίζουσα
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Έδη είναι ελληνική μορφή του ονόματος Εדה, που σημαίνει βοηθήτρια, υποστηρίζουσα. Στην ελληνική παράδοση, το όνομα Έδη συνδέεται με την έννοια της βοήθειας και της υποστήριξης. Δεν υπάρχει άμεση αναφορά στο όνομα Έδη στην Καινή Διαθήκη, αλλά η έννοια της βοήθειας και της υποστήριξης είναι σημαντική στην χριστιανική παράδοση.

in_latin.name: Ede
in_latin.long_meaning: The name Ede is derived from the Hebrew root 'adah', which means helper or supporter. In the Latin tradition, the name Ede is associated with the concept of aid and assistance. Although there is no direct reference to Ede in the Latin Vulgate, the idea of helping and supporting others is a significant theme in Christian tradition.

in_english.name: Ede
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ede is of Hebrew origin, derived from the root 'adah', meaning helper or supporter. It is associated with one of the wives of Lamech, father of Noah, in the Bible (Genesis 4:19-20). In Christian tradition, the name Ede symbolizes assistance, care, and devotion. The name Ede has been used across various Christian cultures, reflecting its universal themes of support and help.

data.spiritual_significance: In Christianity, the name Ede holds significant spiritual meaning as a variant of the name Edith. Edith means 'wealth' or 'fortune' in Old English, implying that the person named Ede is blessed with God's abundant grace and blessings. It serves as a reminder to trust in God's providence and to strive for a life of prosperity and abundance, both spiritually and materially.
